newsitem.title: UK: Imperial confident of legal defences.
newsitem.headline: Imperial confident of legal defences.

text.p: Imperial Tobacco Group Plc said on Wednesday it was confident of its defences against potential health-related litigation from smokers.
"We are very confident that we have very strong defences and will defend any case with the utmost vigour," Imperial chief executive Gareth Davis told Reuters.

Unlike its sector rival B.A.T Industries, Imperial, which is in the process of demerging from Hanson Plc, is not a large player in the U.S. market, but Davis said he followed reports of litigation there.

Davis echoed B.A.T in saying that a verdict last week in Indiana in favour of tobacco companies showed that an earlier case in Florida where a jury ruled in favour of the plaintiff was "something of an aberration", and he noted that the Florida verdict was subject to appeal.
"There have been some 700 cases since the mid-50s and not one cent paid in damages," Davis said.
